title: Corollary 8.5.7 (tangent cones are rectifiable cones), from the sibling results
statement: Assume VarifoldTangentCones, the blow-up density lower bound (second conjunct of the sibling varifold_tangents), AllardRectifiabilityTheorem and FirstRectifiabilityTheorem. The blow-up density lower bound says: if V has locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, τ > 0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ ofReal τ)}) → 0, then every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) has Θ^n(μ_C,·) ≥ ofReal τ μ_C-a.e. Then TangentConesAreRectifiableCones holds. That is, let V have locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, Θ^n(μ_V,x) = θ0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ 1)}) → 0. Then every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) is rectifiable and rescaledMeasure C 0 s = C.measure for all s > 0.
lean_statement: VarifoldTangentCones → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (τ : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → x ∈ U → 0 < τ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ρ * variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x ρ ∧ ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ} / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N)), IsVarifoldTangent V x C → ∀ᵐ y ∂C.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n C.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ) → AllardRectifiabilityTheorem → FirstRectifiabilityTheorem → TangentConesAreRectifiableCones
